cases.procedure: Sign in with a valid username and a wrong password. When the error banner appears, inspect it at 100% zoom in a desktop browser, then once more at a 375px-wide viewport.
cases.expected_outcome: The banner uses an error colour and is readable against the page background, and the copy is specific enough that a non-technical user knows what to do next.
evidence_required: A screenshot of the error banner at desktop width
A screenshot of the error banner at a 375px-wide viewport
